lines: I study computer science and engineering at SRM. My projects use machine learning to find patterns in images. I’ve built tools that add color to grayscale photos, classify brain MRI scans, and identify food in a meal.
I’m based in Modinagar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, and speak Hindi and English.

Education: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering, 2023–2027
SRM Institute of Science and Technology, NCR Campus · CGPA 7.74/10
Technical skills: I code in C, C++, Python, and JavaScript and build web interfaces with HTML and CSS.
For computer vision, I use machine learning and deep learning, including convolutional neural networks. I work with PyTorch, NumPy, Pandas, and Jupyter Notebook.
I build web services with Flask and Spring Boot, work with REST APIs, and test requests in Postman. I use Git and GitHub to track changes.
I’ve studied data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, database management systems, and software engineering.
Publication: AI-Guided Echocardiography for Early Pulmonary Hypertension in Neonates
The paper looks at how AI could help spot high blood pressure in the lungs of newborns using ultrasound images of the heart.

projects.name: Brain Tumour Detection System
projects.detail: I trained the model in PyTorch to recognize patterns in brain scans. I built a Flask web app that prepares an uploaded scan for the model and displays its prediction.
projects.description: Upload a brain MRI scan to see how a deep learning model classifies the image.

images.alt: Grayscale brain MRI from the pituitary class in the test set.
images.label: Classifying a test scan
images.caption: The model classified this test scan as a pituitary tumour, matching the dataset label. It assigned that class a score of 88%.

projects.name: Automatic Image Colorization
projects.detail: I based this project on the paper Colorful Image Colorization. I prepared the training images and built a workflow to train a convolutional neural network and use it to color new photos. I packaged the steps so the experiment can be repeated.
projects.description: Takes a grayscale photo and predicts plausible colors for it.

images.alt: Two versions of the same mountain and river scene, grayscale on the left and colorized on the right.
images.label: Grayscale input and model output
images.caption: The left side shows the original grayscale photo. On the right, the SIGGRAPH 2017 model predicts blue for the sky and green for the trees.

projects.name: Health-Based Meal Scanner
projects.detail: I connected the web interface to Python code that processes the photo. A machine learning model uses the image to identify the meal.
projects.description: Identifies a meal from a photo and uses nutrition information to suggest food choices.

images.alt: A box labeled naan surrounds a flatbread in a saved model prediction.
images.label: Finding food in a photo
images.caption: The box shows where the model detected naan in a validation photo. If someone selects the weight-loss goal, the app suggests a higher-protein, lower-fat portion.
